title: Kiritani Haruka — Bubbly Blue〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: After school
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Rooftop

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Sorry I took so long, everyone...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Huh? You're the only one here, Airi?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Shizuku said she'll be late because she has cleanup committee stuff to do. What about Minori?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: She'll be late because of an animal caretaker committee meeting.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Ah, okay. Then how about we start with some stretches then?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Okay.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: One, two, three, four... Come to think of it, it's kind of rare for us to be alone together, huh?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yeah.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hey, can I ask you something...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Sure, but... Is something wrong?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: No, there's something that's been on my mind ever since we decided to freelance.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: When we were running around trying to find an agency we could join, I was thinking that maybe...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: No, not maybe... You were trying to protect us from whatever we would face, weren't you?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Especially when I suggested that we go independent, you said maybe you were being too stubborn...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: But I don't think that's the case.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Shizuku and I quit because we didn't like how our agencies were treating us or we had problems with other group members.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: It felt like you were being the most careful out of all of us and kept voicing your opinion about one thing after another.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yes, I would be lying if I said I wasn't, but I wouldn't say I was being as careful as you believe I was.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Our futures depended on it, so I just wanted to clear up any concerns or doubts we may've had before moving forward.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Also...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Also?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I didn't want us to make the same mistakes again.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: It may've been for different reasons, but we all gave up being idols once already...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But after meeting Minori, we were somehow able to get back on our feet again.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Because of that, I was determined not to let the hope that Minori had given us to go to waste.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Yes. I feel the same way too.
And I'm sure Shizuku does as well.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Right...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But because I was so focused on that, I wasn't able to think out of the box at all.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: So even though I was surprised when you suggested going independent, I'm actually grateful that you brought it up.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Maybe it's just human nature...
Getting bogged down in our own thoughts.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: If Rin hadn't listened to what was on my mind, I would've probably stayed stuck too.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yeah. We should definitely try to take some time to have more discussions together in the future.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: We should.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: But at any rate...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: You really are the responsible type, huh?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh? I think you're no different in that regard...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: You're by far the most responsible person I've ever known. It's really reassuring to have you around!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I'll be counting on you, Haruka.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Sure. And I'm counting on you too, Airi.
Let's make the best of it, okay?
